targets.rawSql: select count(*) as value from analytics.intents where status = 'active' and archived_at is null

with acts as (
  select user_id as u, created_at as t from analytics.intents
  union all select sender_id, created_at from analytics.messages
  union all select actor_user_id, at from analytics.opportunity_events where type = 'committed'
) select count(distinct a.u) as value from acts a join analytics.users us on us.id = a.u where a.t > now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Active intents per weekly active user

targets.rawSql:
with acts as (
  select user_id as u, created_at as t from analytics.intents
  union all select sender_id, created_at from analytics.messages
  union all select actor_user_id, at from analytics.opportunity_events where type = 'committed'
), w as (select count(distinct a.u) as n from acts a join analytics.users us on us.id = a.u where a.t > now() - interval '7 days') select (select count(*) from analytics.intents where status = 'active' and archived_at is null)::float / nullif((select n from w), 0) as value

select count(*) as value from analytics.networks n
left join (select network_id, max(created_at) as t from analytics.intent_networks group by 1) ia on ia.network_id = n.id
left join (select network_id, max(created_at) as t from analytics.opportunity_networks group by 1) op on op.network_id = n.id
where n.deleted_at is null and coalesce(ia.t, 'epoch'::timestamptz) < now() - interval '14 days' and coalesce(op.t, 'epoch'::timestamptz) < now() - interval '14 days'

panels.title: Intents created and archived per day

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,'1d'), 'created' as metric, count(*) as value from analytics.intents where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1 union all select $__timeGroupAlias(archived_at,'1d'), 'archived', count(*) from analytics.intents where archived_at is not null and $__timeFilter(archived_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Dormant networks (no intent assignment and no opportunity in 14d)

targets.rawSql:
select n.id as network, coalesce(m.members, 0) as members, ia.t as last_intent_assignment, op.t as last_opportunity
from analytics.networks n
left join (select network_id, count(*) as members from analytics.network_members where deleted_at is null group by 1) m on m.network_id = n.id
left join (select network_id, max(created_at) as t from analytics.intent_networks group by 1) ia on ia.network_id = n.id
left join (select network_id, max(created_at) as t from analytics.opportunity_networks group by 1) op on op.network_id = n.id
where n.deleted_at is null and coalesce(ia.t, 'epoch'::timestamptz) < now() - interval '14 days' and coalesce(op.t, 'epoch'::timestamptz) < now() - interval '14 days'
order by members desc limit 50
